columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: PROVIDER_ID
columns.description: Transcoding provider identifier.

columns.name: VIDEO_STATUS
columns.description: Video processing status. {NEW, UPLOADED, TRANSCODING, COMPLETE, ERROR, CANCELLED}

columns.name: THUMBNAILS_STATUS
columns.description: Video thumnails status: {NEW, TRANSCODING, COMPLETE, ERROR, CANCELLED}

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: External storage source URL of the video.

columns.name: SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Source name of the video.

columns.name: PLAYLIST_NAME
columns.description: Playlist name of the video.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: The duration of the video in seconds.

columns.name: DESCRIPTOR
columns.description: Descriptor information of the video.

columns.name: PLAYLIST
columns.description: Play-list inforamtion of the video.

columns.name: KEY_STORE
columns.description: The key(s) for protected content of the video.

columns.name: FRAME_RATE
columns.description: Frame rate in fps of the video.

columns.name: FRAME_WIDTH
columns.description: Frame width in pixels of the video.

columns.name: FRAME_HEIGHT
columns.description: Frame height in pixels of the video.

columns.name: VIDEO_FORMAT
columns.description: Video format of the video.

columns.name: VIDEO_CODEC
columns.description: Video codec of the video.

columns.name: VIDEO_BITRATE
columns.description: Video bit-rate of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_FORMAT
columns.description: Audio format of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_CODEC
columns.description: Audio codec of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_BITRATE
columns.description: Audio bit-rate in kbps of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_CHANNELS
columns.description: Number of audio channels of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE
columns.description: Audio sample rate in Hz of the video.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
